name: com.namepiq/domains
title: Namepiq
description: Search, quote, buy domains via MCP. Device login + human payment links.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start paid domain checkout via Razorpay Payment Link. Returns payment_url for the human to pay, then poll get_checkout_status. Requires verified email + saved contact. Confirm with the user before calling. items: [{domain, years?, auto_renew?}].

items.description: cart lines with domain and optional years/auto_renew

currency.description: ISO currency e.g. USD EUR INR

abandon_pending.description: abandon an open pending checkout first

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a domain (authenticated).

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Create a free domain watch (limits apply). For paid tiers use create_watch_checkout.

tools.name: create_watch_checkout
tools.description: Start paid watch checkout via Razorpay Payment Link. Returns payment_url for the human. tier: standard|priority. Then poll get_watch_checkout_status.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete own comment on a domain.

tools.name: delete_watch
tools.description: Delete/abandon a watch by UUID.

tools.name: get_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll checkout/payment + fulfillment status after create_checkout. Pass checkout_id or razorpay_order_id.

tools.name: get_dns
tools.description: Get OpenSRS Managed DNS records for an owned domain.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get one owned domain by UUID.

tools.name: get_geo
tools.description: Infer shopper country/currency from Cloudflare CF-IPCountry (via API). Use before search when currency unknown.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated user profile and default contact (requires login or NAMEPIQ_TOKEN).

tools.name: get_nameservers
tools.description: Read nameservers for an owned domain.

tools.name: get_watch_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll paid watch status after create_watch_checkout.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List public comments on a domain page.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains owned by the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List domain watches for the authenticated account.

tools.name: login
tools.description: DEPRECATED for chat agents: email/password auth. Prefer start_device_login + poll_device_login so the human signs in via browser (supports Google). Avoid putting passwords in chat.

tools.name: patch_me
tools.description: Update account prefs (e.g. country, preferred_currency).

tools.name: poll_device_login
tools.description: Poll once after start_device_login. Call this repeatedly every ~5s right after start_device_login (do not wait for the human to say they approved). Returns authorization_pending (keep polling), slow_down (wait longer), or authorized with access_token stored for this MCP session. Prefer this over the password login tool.

device_code.description: optional; defaults to device_code from start_device_login in this session

tools.name: push_domain_contacts
tools.description: Push the account default contact to OpenSRS for this domain (owner/admin/billing/tech).

tools.name: quote_domain
tools.description: Get a multi-year retail quote for an exact domain (1,2,3,5 years). Optional ISO currency. Money: amount_minor + currency (ISO minor units) and amount_display. price_paise is a deprecated alias of amount_minor. Does not purchase or create accounts.

currency.description: ISO currency e.g. USD EUR INR

tools.name: register
tools.description: Create a Namepiq account. Returns access_token and stores it for this session. User must verify email before checkout.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Ops/reseller path: register via OpenSRS charging the reseller balance (no end-user Razorpay). For shoppers prefer create_checkout + payment_url. Confirm with the user before calling.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew an owned domain for additional years.

tools.name: resend_verification
tools.description: Resend the email verification link (requires login).

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Check domain availability and retail prices for a query or FQDN. Optional ISO currency (INR,USD,EUR,...). Money fields: amount_minor (ISO minor units for currency) and amount_display (e.g. USD 122.10). price_paise is a deprecated alias of amount_minor — not always Indian paise. Does not purchase or create accounts.

query.description: domain keyword or FQDN to search

currency.description: ISO currency e.g. USD EUR INR

tools.name: set_dns
tools.description: Replace OpenSRS Managed DNS zone records for an owned domain. Pass records as returned by get_dns (array of record objects).

tools.name: set_nameservers
tools.description: Replace nameservers for an owned domain (unlock may be required).

tools.name: start_device_login
tools.description: Preferred sign-in for MCP (including Google accounts). Returns verification_uri_complete and user_code. REQUIRED agent behavior: (1) show the human verification_uri_complete once, (2) immediately begin calling poll_device_login every ~5s until authorized/denied/expired — do not wait for the human to confirm approval in chat. Do not ask for passwords in chat.

client_name.description: optional label e.g. cursor or claude

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: OpenSRS name suggestions for a brand or keyword. Optional comma-separated tlds override (otherwise OpenSRS suggestion defaults). Does not purchase or create accounts.

tools.name: top_watched
tools.description: Top watched domains (public).

tools.name: update_domain
tools.description: Update lock and/or auto-renew flags on an owned domain.

tools.name: upsert_contact
tools.description: Create/update the account's default registrant contact used for registrations.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify email with the token from the verification email link (query ?token=).

tools.name: watch_prices
tools.description: Paid watch tier prices in a currency (standard ~$1, priority ~$5, 1 month each).

tools.name: watch_status
tools.description: Public watch interest status for a domain.
